entities.name: Girolamo della Robbia

entities.summary: Girolamo della Robbia was an Italian Renaissance sculptor, mostly in the family style of glazed terracotta, the youngest son of Andrea della Robbia, together with his brother Giovanni della Robbia were among the most active collaborators in the family workshop.
